A '''react''' is a special deployment or movement, allowed by cards that say "react", made during the opponent's turn. It happens just after the opponent initiates a [[battle]] or [[Force drain]], and lets the player deploy or move cards to that location at normal use of the Force.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref>

A reacting card must follow all deployment or movement rules. Reacting to a Force drain cancels it if the player brings presence to the location; reacting away from a battle cancels the battle if the player removes their presence. Each card that deploys or moves is a separate react, and cards that react cannot react again that turn.<ref name="gl20" />
